div.ab: XCVI. Se ðe dyrnum geðingum betogen sy, geladie hine be CXX hida ðara geþinga oþþe CXX scll' gesylle.
XCVI. Se ðe diernum geðingum betygen sie, geswicne hine be CXX hida þara geðingea oððe CXX scill. geselle.
Qui de occultis actionibus fuerit accusatus, neget CXX hidis ipsum actum aut CXX sol. emendet.
{XCVI} Se ðe diernum geðingum betygen sie, geswicne hine be CXX hida þara geðingea oððe CXX sciƚƚ geselle.
He who is accused of [making] secret compacts, let him clear himself of [the accusation of making] those compacts by [an oath of the value of] 120 hides, or let him pay 120 shillings.
He who is accused of making an illicit compact shall clear himself from the charge with [an oath worth] 120 hides, or pay 120 shillings.
He who is accused of secret compacts, is to clear himself of [complicity] in the compacts with [an oath of] 120 hides, or pay 120 shillings.
Wer heimlicher Abfindungen beschuldigt wird, schwöre sich von solchen Abfindungen rein durch [Eid von] 120 Hiden, oder zahle [dem Gerichtsherrn] 120 Schill.
Whoever is accused of secret settlements, let him swear himself clear of such settlements by [an oath of] 120 hides, or pay [the lord of the court] 120 shillings.
